final: SELECT a.atom_id AS atom_1_id, a.element AS atom_1_element, b.atom_id AS atom_2_id, b.element AS atom_2_element FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom AS b ON b.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3' UNION SELECT a.atom_id, a.element, b.atom_id, b.element FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom AS b ON b.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3' AND c.atom_id <> c.atom_id2
